description: This source file defines the Customer class within the Opencart.System.Library.Cart namespace for the OpenCart platform. It manages customer-related data and actions such as login, logout, and data retrieval, and interacts with the database and session objects.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents a customer in the OpenCart system, providing methods to handle customer data and authentication processes.

methods.name: Customer __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Customer object, retrieving customer data from the database if a customer ID exists in the session.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a customer using email and password, manages password rehashing, and updates session data.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears customer session and resets customer properties.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Checks if a customer is currently logged in based on customer ID presence.

methods.name: getNewsletter
methods.description: Returns whether the customer is subscribed to the newsletter.

methods.name: isSafe
methods.description: Returns whether the customer is marked as safe.

methods.name: isCommenter
methods.description: Returns whether the customer is a commenter.

methods.name: getAddressId
methods.description: Retrieves the default address ID for the customer.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Returns the total balance of the customer's transactions.

methods.name: getRewardPoints
methods.description: Returns the total reward points accumulated by the customer.
